checks.note: Page lists Basic Auth (api_id/api_token, own account) and OAuth 2.0 for Technology Partners building multi-company apps. Bearer token, non-expiring, and client_id/secret issued by Aircall after an application form are all stated. OAuth is a requirement for Marketplace listing.

The page confirms keys are created in Company Settings > API Keys and OAuth credentials need partner signup. It states no plan requirement, free tier or sandbox. 'paid_plan' is an inference, not a documented fact.

REST. The page covers a broad set of resources: Users, Teams, Calls, Conversations, Contacts, Numbers, Messages, Tags, Webhooks, Campaigns, Analytics, AI Voice Agents. Rate limit of 120 requests/min per company and the 10,000-item cap on Calls and Contacts are stated. The page does not state that the Users V1 deprecation is under way.

The MCP FAQ (updated 2026-09-04) says 'As of this writting we don't offer an MCP servier but stay tuned.' This is time-bound. Search shows only third-party servers (e.g. the Allo/@allo/aircall-mcp-server npm package, StackOne, Zapier, CData), so 'community' fits. I did not fetch those pages individually. The FAQ lives on developer.aircall.io, a different host than the api-references page.

ready_with_caveats follows from the fields. The caveats (admin-created keys, partner approval for OAuth, 120/min limit, 10k caps, entitlement-gated endpoints) are documented. The 'no free or sandbox path' wording is an absence of evidence, not a stated fact.

corrected.one_liner: Aircall is a cloud-based business phone and call center platform that integrates with CRMs and helpdesks for calling, SMS, and conversation analytics.
corrected.auth_notes: Basic Auth (api_id as username, api_token as password) for customers accessing their own account. OAuth 2.0 for Technology Partners building multi-company apps; tokens are sent as Bearer and don't expire. OAuth client_id/secret must be requested from Aircall via the partner signup form.
corrected.access_notes: Basic Auth keys are created in Company Settings > API Keys, which requires an existing Aircall account. The docs state no minimum plan, free tier or sandbox, so the 'paid_plan' label is inferred from needing an Aircall account and is unverified. OAuth requires partner signup and Aircall issuing credentials. Some endpoints need entitlements (Analytics+, AI Assist, Conversations enabled by Aircall).
corrected.blocker: Needs an Aircall account with admin rights for Basic Auth keys (no free or sandbox path documented). Multi-tenant OAuth needs partner approval. Rate limit is 120 requests/min per company. Calls and Contacts lists cap at 10,000 items. Aircall has no official MCP server per its FAQ (updated 2026-09-04, time-bound wording); only third-party ones exist.
